conversations.prompt: What's a book you would never want adapted into a movie or TV series because it would lose something important?
conversations.response: I believe the Twilight Saga books should never have been adapted into movies because they lose much of the depth, emotion and character development that make the novels so engaging.

conversations.prompt: Which author do you think has the most recognisable writing style, and what makes it so distinctive?
conversations.response: R.L. Stine has a recognisable writing style because he uses simple, short chapters, along with lots of suspense and cliffhangers. His stories often create a feeling of mystery and fear while keeping the reader wanting to know what happens next. His use of unexpected twists, creepy settings and relatable young characters also makes his writing distinctive.
